blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in West Newton fell from 106 in June to 83 in September (−21.7%), and 43 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 7.4% of Surrey’s 1,120 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in West Newton?
West Newton also had 130 condos and townhomes listed and 8 sold in September, against 83 houses listed. The West Newton condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in West Newton?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 83 houses listed in West Newton. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is West Newton a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in West Newton had a sales ratio of 20%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in West Newton from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 43 houses sold in West Newton over those 4 months, out of 351 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in West Newton?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
